content: Use the company’s patented low-code development platform to configure Web applications and GJXML interface.
Maintain understanding of current Web technologies or programming practices in the company’s interface engine based on the latest trends in computer and information science.
Analyze user needs to determine technical requirements.
Create Web models or prototypes that include physical, interface, logical, or data models.
Confer with management or development teams to prioritize needs, resolve conflicts, develop content criteria, or choose solutions.

Recommend and implement performance improvements.
Document technical factors such as server load, bandwidth, database performance, and browser and device types.
Communicate with network personnel to address hardware or software issues affecting Web sites.
